changes.interest: Current loan, lender and date input/change recompute detail interest and totals immediately; an open start-date editor previews its selected date with current unsaved financing. Closing restores the existing date with current financing.
changes.fallback: Unavailable calculation clears previous automatic values; saved manual fallback on another vehicle and sold snapshots remain intact.
changes.dateOnlySave: The date and derived stored interest use persisted financing; unsaved loan, price and memo drafts are preserved. Generic authorized vehicle scope allows a missing plate without weakening owner/account/company/context/CAS guards.
changes.personalSettings: One existing server preference per company_id,user_id is reused in detail and registration. New settings gear supports visibility, custom field creation and definition removal.
changes.amounts: Hidden/removed registration definitions keep typed values, DOM nodes and labels; strict integer-KRW amounts and normalized labels persist as top-level customCosts/customCostLabels and enter existing totals.
changes.controls: Registration additional-cost controls are compact blue plus and red minus icons.
changes.lateResponses: Stable dealer cache is separated from captured view/session/actor/client/permission. Stale successful or uncertain saves invalidate same-account cache and fetch the current authorized server state. Late-created inputs join the existing save/retry lock.

validation.existingDetailCostNote: Passed on immediately preceding source; the final added guard is registration-only and received independent review plus held-ACK browser coverage.

productionMetadata.scope: read-only function and primary-key metadata, no preference or business payloads

limitations: Browser checks use actual application sources with synthetic authentication, RPC and owner-CAS responses; no production vehicle or dealer preference was changed for testing.
